scope: Existing JCMIT R/B/P source versions and selected evidence; publication is not a new experimental run.

B.role: Matched counterfactual source-reader control; not a historical released build

P.role: Deployment configuration associated with six retained synthetic-case outputs

R_B_provenance.method: A separate Git history captured the main working-tree bytes, including uncommitted files. B reverted only three boundary-related files; R restored those files to the captured working-tree contents.

corpus.note: Exact frozen corpus remains locally archived. A current download is not a byte-identical substitute.

limits: R/B replay contains no model generation.
P is a separate deployment configuration and does not validate the R reader repair.
This package does not include the private raw P account records or the full frozen corpus.
IMP E/E2/E3 configurations are not published by this version package.
